ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle PQR, point S is on the base QR, so Q, S, R are collinear. Sides PQ and PR are marked with the same notation, indicating PQ=PR; segments QS and PS are marked with the same notation, indicating QS=PS. At vertex P, angle RPS is marked as 75°. Reasoning: Let ∠QRP = x. Because PQ=PR, triangle PQR is an isosceles triangle, and the base angles are equal, so ∠PQR = x. Since S is on QR, ray QS is collinear with QR, so ∠PQS = ∠PQR = x. In triangle PQS, QS=PS, so the angles opposite them are equal, namely ∠QPS = ∠PQS = x. The whole vertex angle ∠QPR = ∠QPS + ∠RPS = x + 75°. In triangle PQR, the sum of the interior angles is 180°, so x + x + (x+75°) = 180°, obtaining 3x = 105°, therefore x = 35°.

raw_record.question_text: In triangle $PQR$, the lengths of sides $PQ$ and $PR$ are the same. The point $S$ lies on $QR$ so that $QS=PS$ and $\angle RPS=75^{\circ}$. What is the size of $\angle QRP$?

method.method_draft: Direct angle chase. Read from the diagram/text that Q, S, R are collinear, PQ=PR, QS=PS, and angle RPS is 75°. Let x = angle QRP. Since PQ=PR, triangle PQR is isosceles, so angle PQR = x. Because S lies on QR, angle PQS is also x. In triangle PQS, QS=PS, so the angles opposite those equal sides are equal: angle QPS = angle PQS = x. The whole vertex angle angle QPR is angle QPS + angle RPS = x + 75°. But in triangle PQR, the angles sum to 180°, so x + x + (x+75)=180. Hence 3x=105 and x=35°.

图像描述：图中是三角形 PQR，点 S 在底边 QR 上，因此 Q、S、R 共线。边 PQ 和 PR 用相同记号标出，表示 PQ=PR；线段 QS 和 PS 用相同记号标出，表示 QS=PS。顶点 P 处，角 RPS 标为 75°。

推理：设 ∠QRP = x。因为 PQ=PR，所以三角形 PQR 是等腰三角形，底角相等，故 ∠PQR = x。由于 S 在 QR 上，射线 QS 与 QR 同线，所以 ∠PQS = ∠PQR = x。在三角形 PQS 中，QS=PS，因此它们所对的角相等，即 ∠QPS = ∠PQS = x。整个顶角 ∠QPR = ∠QPS + ∠RPS = x + 75°。在三角形 PQR 中，内角和为 180°，所以 x + x + (x+75°) = 180°，得到 3x = 105°，因此 x = 35°。

method.method_draft: Trigonometric length route. Let x = angle QRP and let PR=PQ=a. Since triangle PQR is isosceles with base angle x, its base length is QR=2a cos x. In triangle PRS, angle RPS=75° and angle PRS=x because S lies on QR, so angle PSR=180°-75°-x=105°-x. By the sine rule in triangle PRS, PS/a = sin x / sin(105°-x) and SR/a = sin 75° / sin(105°-x). Since QS=PS and QR=QS+SR, divide by a to get 2 cos x = [sin x + sin 75°]/sin(105°-x). Thus 2 cos x sin(105°-x)=sin x+sin75°. Using 2cos x sin(105°-x)=sin105°+sin(105°-2x) and sin105°=sin75°, this reduces to sin(105°-2x)=sin x. The valid angle solution is 105°-2x=x, so x=35°.

设 x=∠QRP，并令 PR=PQ=a。因为三角形 PQR 是等腰三角形，所以 ∠PQR=∠QRP=x，底边 QR=2a cos x。

在三角形 PRS 中，由于 S 在 QR 上，所以 ∠PRS=∠QRP=x。又已知 ∠RPS=75°，因此 ∠PSR=180°-75°-x=105°-x。

对三角形 PRS 用正弦定理：
PS/a = sin x / sin(105°-x)，
SR/a = sin75° / sin(105°-x)。

因为 QS=PS，且 QR=QS+SR，所以
2a cos x = PS+SR。
两边除以 a 得：
2 cos x = [sin x + sin75°] / sin(105°-x)。
因此
2 cos x sin(105°-x)=sin x+sin75°。

利用恒等式 2cos x sin(105°-x)=sin105°+sin(105°-2x)，且 sin105°=sin75°，方程化为：
sin(105°-2x)=sin x。

在有效几何范围内，取 105°-2x=x，得到 3x=105°，所以 x=35°。因此 ∠QRP=35°。
